text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen! Carrying the dreams of 
recovery on its shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
So many things have happened this year! 
Yet now, we are—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She is overcoming those hardships and 
trying to get back on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The year-end spectacle, the Arima Kinen. 
Who will claim the ultimate victory? And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will show us a new "hope" 
for the upcoming year...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering it was a year of national 
crisis, the atmosphere isn't very festive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pressure mounts on the Umamusume 
whether they like it or not, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A single page... of history.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No matter how joyful the year, no matter 
how painful the year—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Viewed from above, it's just another page 
in history. What must be done does not 
change from year to year. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Simply and methodically— “fulfill the 
victory conditions.”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is but one phase in the bittersweet 
game we call history. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The commander remained unfazed. Even under 
this intense pressure, they calmly 
assessed the situation from a higher 
vantage point.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm going to have some fun. And 
so will Kiseki and the Thunder Goddess 
Sisters.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Observe my moves carefully. I will etch 
the finest move of this era... for your 
future reference.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yo, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup! Counting on you today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(All the big names are here. The three 
from my generation, and Buena too. But—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The unit boasting the greatest firepower 
today is—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Presenting Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume with the presence of a "King" 
makes her majestic descent onto the Arima 
Kinen stage!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(...Orfevre-san, huh. An Umamusume hailed 
as the next-generation king.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Hmph, but the next ruler is me. It is 
me... and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... this pressure... This person is 
just...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(It's hard to disobey... She just looks so 
imposing standing there... M-My body 
won't...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership froze completely, unable to move 
a muscle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell what's going on from this far 
away, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they got swallowed up by the 
pressure. How unfortunate for them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume naturally sense each other's 
strength. Orfe... is strong.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah... Urgh... Well... you see...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I permit it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: We permit it. To serve Us.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh... What did you say...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, from what I have heard, you are fond 
of games. If so――

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do that outside the King's chambers. The 
racetrack is no place for frivolous games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Guh…….

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (It's no useee... I can't say a word...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I'm really not good with this type... I 
can't... seize the initiative...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership was just silently listening, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Where is your response? Looking at your 
conduct... I cannot help but feel there is 
a severe lack of supervision.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yours—as a Trainer, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ââ!? What... on earth...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You seem like an ignorant fool who can't 
even manage their own trainee, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What did... you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: She's... she's not... She's not ignorant.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
She...! She understood and accepted 
everything, and stuck by me all the way 
here!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I must not. I cannot wake the crouching 
dragon.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I came from a prestigious 
academy, I wasn't an honor student. Even 
so—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
She stayed by my side and supported my 
dream all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to broaden my 
strategy, elevate my perspective, and make 
it this far.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Your judgment—is mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ho... you dare voice dissent against me, 
your king?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"A king? Don't make me laugh. Not to sound 
rich coming from a gamer like me, but take 
a look at the real world, would you?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not a single leader here calls themselves 
a king. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The world is brimming with 'strategies.' 
Those with the best strategies are the 
ones who take the world by storm."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Please look at the board, Orfevre-san. 
This is not the Middle Ages.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The era of the King will never come again. 
Ever. The next ruler—is me.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Rulership has managed to 
take down the mighty Orfevre...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's taunting them! Rulership makes a 
bold move!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... It seems you've finally awakened.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well, then. Entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What...? You... don't tell me you did that 
on purpose...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"And besides... when it comes to trading 
barbs, I won't be left in the dust 
either."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn the tables on them. Hey—it's 
showtime.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, and you are...?

The era of the King will never come... you 
say?
If you put it that way...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The giant squid is totally furious, dude! 
What are we gonna do about the yakisoba 
ingredients?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Gold Ship-san?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Ship Brother! Word is, you raise 
quite a ruckus yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Can you pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by... 'do it'?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: OF COURSE IT'S DECIDED, DAMMIT!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is the real deal! Screw up or get 
screwed over. Or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Maracas!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don-don chicken, don chicken!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this person's deal...? I mean, I 
know that's just the kind of Umamusume she 
is, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Did Orfevre-san call for me? For what 
purpose...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intrusion of the free-spirited 
Umamusume, Gold Ship. Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To stir up chaos against Rulership's race 
control. Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Rulership misses the start, to keep 
others from targeting her from behind, 
I'll strike from even further back—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—well now, I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Tch, this is without a doubt— the 
highest-difficulty scenario.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The King at the front gate, the Gold Ship 
at the back...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(A scenario akin to a "Golden Pincer 
Attack," you could say. However—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This feeling in my hands... This 
is it. This is what I've been waiting 
for...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall make it known to the spectators, 
and to future generations. By clearing 
this brilliantly, that I am the true 
ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There is no board state I cannot read 
right now. Yes, I am the ruler of this 
game—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's the ruler!
